quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Trixeo approved in the EU for the maintenance treatment of (09-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The European Commission approved Trixeo Aerosphere (budesonide/glycopyrronium/formoterol fumarate dihydrate; marketed as Breztri Aerosphere in the US, China and Japan) as a maintenance treatment for asthma in patients 12 years of age and older not adequately controlled by a medium dose ICS/LABA combination, following the positive CHMP opinion. The approval is based on the KALOS and LOGOS Phase III trials (approximately 4,300 randomised patients), in which Trixeo showed statistically significant improvements in lung function versus combined ICS/LABA comparators and, in the pooled analysis, a statistically significant reduction in the annualised rate of severe asthma exacerbations; no new safety or tolerability signals were identified. Trixeo/Breztri is now approved for asthma in the US, Europe and Japan and is under review in China and other countries; it is also approved for COPD in more than 90 countries and was prescribed to more than 6.8 million patients globally in 2025. The company says Trixeo is the first and only triple-combination therapy approved in the EU for patients 12 years and older, independent of exacerbation history (company claim).
